summary: Concord Medical Services Holdings Ltd (NYSE: CCM) filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO Wei Jiang effective June 30, 2026, and the appointment of Botao Shi as interim CFO. The departure is to allow Jiang to focus on the subsidiary Concord Healthcare Group (HK:2453) and was not due to any disagreement. No material terms, consideration, or premium were involved. The filing is a standard management change disclosure for a foreign private issuer. Watch for any subsequent strategic shifts or financial reporting impacts under new interim CFO.
